name: lizard
description: Deploy and manage apps, databases, sandboxes and Lizard Git repositories on Lizard (lizard.build) from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy apps, run sandboxes and host repos on Lizard
interface.longDescription: Connect Lizard once, then ask ChatGPT or Codex to ship a service from a GitHub or Lizard Git repo, read logs, set secrets, scale replicas, attach a domain, provision a managed Postgres/Redis/S3 addon, run code in a sandbox, or open and merge a pull request — in plain words. Scoped to your own Lizard workspaces and projects.
